name: Trevor Jones
title: Bassist
tagline: Shaping sound at the intersection of theater, rock, and the orchestral tradition.
bio: Trevor Jones is a Chicago-based bassist and co-founder of [Double Bass HQ](https://doublebasshq.com/). He serves as House Bassist and Music Coordinator at the [Marriott Theatre](https://www.marriotttheatre.com/) in Lincolnshire, IL, — see his credits. He also freelances widely across the Chicago area and writes and performs in the alternative rock band [Molehill](https://www.molehillmusic.com/), which has toured nationally and earned coverage in the Chicago Tribune.
Trevor endorses [Gallien-Krueger](https://www.gallien-krueger.com/) amplifiers and cabinets and is a [D'Addario](https://www.daddario.com/) Artist.
highlights: House Bassist & Music Coordinator, The Marriott Theatre (Lincolnshire, IL)
